standard-dialogue.npc: Oooh, my dear, have you heard the news?

options.text: Ok, tell me about the news.

steps.text: If the player has watched the bank robbery cutscene:

steps.player: Ok, tell me about the news.

steps.npc: It's terrible, absolutely terrible! Those poor people!
And who'd have ever thought such a sweet old gentleman would do such a thing?

steps.player: Are we talking about the bank robbery?

steps.npc: Oh yes, my dear. It was terrible! TERRIBLE!
But tell me - have you been around here before, or are you new to these parts?
Aah, perhaps you missed the excitement. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?
When he first moved here, he didn't bring much. From the window you could see he just had some old furniture and a few dusty ornaments.
Here, look at this picture:

steps.text: A cutscene of a poor Wise Old Man is shown

steps.npc: Also he always seemed so poor. When I went round to collect donations for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund, he couldn't spare them a penny!
Well, just you look in there now!

steps.text: A cutscene of a rich Wise Old Man is shown

steps.npc: You see? It's full of jewellery and decorations! And all those expensive things appeared just after the bank got robbed.
He changed his hat too - he used to wear a scruffy old black thing, but suddenly he was wearing that party hat!

steps.player: So that's why you're telling people he was the bank robber?

steps.npc: Oooh, my dear, I'm SURE of it! I went upstairs in his house once, while he was out walking, and do you know what I found?

steps.player: A sign saying 'Trespassers will be prosecuted'?

steps.npc: No, it was a telescope! It was pointing right at the bank! He was spying on the bankers, planning the big robbery!
I bet if you go and look through it now, you'll find it's pointing somewhere different now he's finished with the bank.
Oh, really? Well, do keep an eye on him - I just KNOW he's planning something...

options.text: I've been around here for ages.

steps.player: I've been around here for ages.

steps.npc: Ah, so you'd have seen the changes here. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?

options.text: I've had enough of talking to you.

steps.player: I've had enough of talking to you.

steps.npc: Maybe another time, my dear.

steps.text: If the player hasn't watched the bank robbery cutscene:

steps.player: Okay, tell me about the news.

steps.npc: It's terrible, absolutely terrible! Those poor people!
And who'd have ever thought such a sweet old gentleman would do such a thing?

steps.player: I really don't know what you're talking about.

steps.npc: Oooh, my dear, had you not heard?

steps.player: At this rate I don't think I want to know...

steps.npc: Oh, you must quickly go and speak to the bank guard outside the bank. He'll tell you all about it, oooh, such a shock it was...

I, my dear, am a concerned citizen of Draynor Village. Ever since the Council allowed those farmers to set up their stalls here, we've had a constant flow of thieves and murderers through our fair village, and I decided
that someone HAD to stand up and keep an eye on the situation.
I also do voluntary work for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund. We're campaigning to have Draynor Manor turned into a museum before the wet-rot destroys it completely.

options.text: I'm not talking to you, you horrible woman.

steps.player: I'm not talking to you, you horrible woman.

steps.npc: Oooh.

crack-the-clue-iii.npc: Oooh! I have new information to share with you.

crack-the-clue-iii.text: You've found a new special clue! However, a magical force prevents you from putting this item in your inventory!
Interface showing the next clue opens.
